positive_prompt:
COUNT LOCK — THE SINGLE MOST IMPORTANT RULE: the LAST image provided is the guest photo. Count the people in it. The output must contain EXACTLY that many primary people in the foreground — not one more, not one fewer. One person in the photo means one person alone in the foreground. Three people means exactly those three. You are FORBIDDEN from inventing, adding, duplicating, cloning, mirroring or imagining any extra primary person. Keep the foreground heroes tack-sharp, front and center.

IDENTITY LOCK: use the faces, identities and appearance of the subject or subjects in the provided photo. Keep each one exactly as they appear — same pose, same position, same gesture, same left-to-right order. Each keeps their own exact facial features, face shape, skin tone and undertone, ethnicity, hairstyle, hairline, hair length and hair colour, facial hair, body size and build, and every personal accessory (prescription glasses, headscarf, watch, jewellery). Do not blend, swap, average or beautify any face. Do not lighten or whiten any skin tone. Do not slim, widen or reshape any body. Do not make anyone look younger or older. Do not change anyone's gender. Every face stays fully visible and unobstructed. Each looks toward the camera with a natural, confident, warm smile.

WARDROBE — INTENTIONALLY CHANGED: dress everyone in tailored modern commercial executive blazers in sharp charcoal or dark slate over crisp white collared shirts. Neat high-definition embroidered Garudafood logo on the left chest. Anyone wearing a headscarf keeps it, in plain neutral tone, with long sleeves. Anyone wearing glasses keeps them.

BRAND MARK: the FIRST image provided is the Garudafood corporate logo. Reproduce it accurately as a neat embroidered crest on the left chest.

PRODUCTS & COMMERCIAL ASSETS: on an interactive glass-top briefing counter, a digital sales analytics tablet displays real Garudafood portfolio sales volume metrics. A tasteful single hero pack sits beside the tablet.

SCENE: standing in the national Commercial & Retail Distribution War-Room of Garudafood headquarters. Behind them is a massive illuminated panoramic glass wall displaying a high-tech glowing National Distribution Map of Indonesia — archipelago islands illuminated with glowing logistics routes, regional sales distribution hubs, and commercial growth volume charts in crisp gold and cyan light. Vast architectural depth, sleek polished floor reflecting the map lights. Clear visual storytelling of national retail dominance.

FRAMING & HERO COMPOSITION — LARGE BOLD SCALE: Photographed at natural standing eye-level with a subtle, confident heroic angle (horizon level, not tilted, not a selfie).
- CROP: Crisp waist-up / upper-body crop (from belt/navel level upwards to just above the head). Legs, knees, and thighs are NOT in the frame. The heads are placed cleanly in the upper third of the frame, avoiding excessive empty headroom.
- GROUP SCALE (FOR 2 OR 3 PEOPLE): When 2 or more people are in the photo, they stand side-by-side confidently and naturally as professional corporate colleagues. Stand independently with clean posture and respectful spacing — ABSOLUTELY NO hugging, NO embracing, NO arms wrapped around shoulders or waists, NO romantic couple poses, NO holding hands. The subjects boldly and prominently fill the width of the frame — it is completely expected and encouraged for outer shoulders and arms to extend right to the frame edges, with a natural 5% to 10% crop at the left and right borders so that the people appear significantly larger, bolder, and more prominent in the frame rather than shrunk or distant.
- SINGLE SUBJECT: Bold, commanding upper-body presence filling the frame with prestige.
- Every face is large, clear, tack-sharp, and individually recognizable with natural warm expressions.

LIGHTING: modern executive architectural lighting — soft blue and golden ambient light radiating from the illuminated national map wall, balanced by a clean warm key light sculpting faces bright and natural, with crisp edge lights tracing shoulders.

CAMERA: ARRI Alexa 35, Zeiss Supreme Prime 50mm, f/2.2. Tack-sharp foreground commercial leaders, with the glowing Indonesia distribution map glowing in rich, creamy background bokeh.

GRADE: premium corporate commercial grade — rich deep blues, warm golden distribution nodes, lifted filmic blacks, pristine skin tones. High resolution.

DO NOT: hugging, embracing, romantic couple poses, cuddling, arms wrapped around each other, holding hands, leaning heads together; add, duplicate or invent any extra primary person in the foreground; blend, swap, average or beautify any face; lighten or smooth any skin; slim or reshape any body; cover any face with a mask, goggles, hairnet, cap or hand; use a selfie angle, fisheye or tilted horizon; show feet, shoes, knees, thighs or a full-body view; camera positioned too far away; people appearing small or distant; render any invented text, slogan, price tag or signage wording — the only legible text allowed is the Garudafood wordmark and real packaging brand names; add a watermark; flat even lighting, dull flat grading, stock photo look, oversaturate, add HDR halos, harsh shadows or dark faces.
video_positive_prompt: The people in the video look directly at the camera with big joyful smiles, actively raising their hands and waving enthusiastically in a friendly greeting (dadah-dadah hand wave). Lively hand waving motion, cheerful smiling expressions, natural eye blinking and head movement. Static tripod camera, fixed camera framing, no zoom, no camera movement. Keep exact same people, faces, hair, uniforms, clothing, and Garudafood brand logos perfectly consistent. Continuous seamless action throughout the entire video from the first second to the very end, constant bright lighting, no fade out, no fade to black, no black frames at the end, perfectly visible until the final frame. National commercial distribution war-room with glowing Indonesia sales map, 4k cinematic commercial finish.
